For a **European upper-upscale hotel**, the following brands typically form the owner/developer longlist. Exact positioning varies by operator—European groups often use **“premium”** where STR-style classifications use **“upper-upscale.”**

### Core pan-European shortlist

| Hotel group | Commonly shortlisted brands | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Le Méridien, Delta Hotels** | Full-service city, business, conference and resort hotels |
|  | **Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio** | Distinctive conversions, heritage buildings and owner-led designs |
| **Hilton** | **Hilton Hotels & Resorts, DoubleTree by Hilton** | Mainstream full-service and conversion projects |
|  | **Curio Collection, Canopy by Hilton** | Independent/lifestyle or design-led assets; Hilton reports strong owner demand for its lifestyle and collection brands in EMEA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-to-double-lifestyle-portfolio-in-emea?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Crowne Plaza, voco** | Crowne Plaza for corporate/MICE demand; voco is particularly conversion-friendly |
|  | **Hotel Indigo** | Boutique, neighbourhood-led urban hotels; IHG highlights its flexible design and build model for owners. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/hotel-indigo?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Pullman, Mövenpick, Swissôtel** | Accor’s principal premium full-service options |
|  | **MGallery** | Historic, boutique and individually designed hotels |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | **Radisson Blu** | One of the most natural European upper-upscale candidates, with particularly broad regional recognition |
|  | **Park Plaza, Radisson Individuals** | Park Plaza for contemporary city hotels; Individuals for flexible affiliations/conversions |
| **Hyatt** | **Hyatt Regency, Hyatt Centric** | Regency for larger business/MICE assets; Centric for lifestyle-oriented city hotels |
|  | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Highly distinctive, historic or resort assets—although Hyatt now places Unbound in its luxury portfolio. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/1-26-2026-RecordPipeline?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Minor Hotels** | **NH Collection, nhow, Tivoli** | Especially relevant in Southern Europe, Benelux, Germany, Austria and Italy; NH Collection has strong European premium positioning. ([euamcareers.minorhotels.com](https://euamcareers.minorhotels.com/job/Madrid-Senior-Brand-Manager-NH-Collection-%28B2C%29-Minor-Hotels-Eu%26Am-Madrid/1362049257/?utm_source=openai)) |

### Regional or project-specific additions

Depending on geography and demand profile, owners may also consider:

- **Park Plaza / art’otel** — particularly London, Amsterdam and selected Central European markets; both are explicitly positioned in the upper-upscale space. ([pphe.com](https://www.pphe.com/development/development-approach?utm_source=openai))
- **Meliá Hotels & Resorts, INNSiDE by Meliá** — especially Iberia, Mediterranean resorts and selected German/UK cities.
- **Leonardo Royal or Leonardo Limited Edition** — particularly Germany, Austria, Benelux, the UK and Central Europe.
- **Barceló Hotels & Resorts** — Iberia and Mediterranean leisure markets.
- **Dolce by Wyndham or Wyndham Grand** — conference, resort and selected city projects.
- **Eurostars Hotels** — Spain, Portugal, Italy and selected historic European cities.
- **Scandic** — Nordic projects where local corporate distribution and operating efficiency outweigh international luxury positioning.

### Practical “first-call” shortlist

For a conventional **200–350-key city-centre new build**, owners would often start with:

1. Marriott Hotels or Sheraton  
2. Hilton or DoubleTree  
3. Radisson Blu  
4. Crowne Plaza or voco  
5. Pullman or Mövenpick  
6. Hyatt Regency  
7. NH Collection  

For a **conversion, heritage or design-led property**, the shortlist usually shifts toward:

- Autograph Collection  
- Curio Collection  
- MGallery  
- Hotel Indigo  
- Tribute Portfolio  
- The Unbound Collection  
- Radisson Individuals  
- NH Collection  

The final shortlist should be narrowed by **territorial availability, room count, meeting-space requirement, capex/PIP burden, franchise versus management preference, fee structure, loyalty-program contribution and the proposed competitive set**. Radisson Blu deserves particular attention in Europe: Radisson describes it as the region’s leading upper-upscale brand, while Park Plaza is also explicitly positioned as upper-upscale. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/about-us/our-team/elie-younes?utm_source=openai))
